sh: Ukraine hits Crimea bridge; Kyiv bridges struck
headline: Ukraine collapses part of the bridge to Crimea as Russian strikes damage bridges in Kyiv
summary: A Ukrainian strike brought down part of the Kerch Bridge, which links Russia to occupied Crimea, on the night of 16 to 17 November. Overnight Russian attacks damaged two main bridges in Kyiv and killed two people there, Ukrainian officials said.
why: The Kerch Bridge is a key supply route for Russian troops and a symbol of Russia’s control of Crimea. The attacks come two days before Putin is due to meet Trump and Xi in Shenzhen, where the war may be discussed.

event.t: Ukraine attacked the Kerch Bridge for the second night in a row. Images checked by NBC News show a section of the road bridge collapsed into the water.
Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed the attack and called it unprecedented.
Traffic on the bridge was stopped. Crimea’s Russian-installed leader, Sergei Aksyonov, said a Ukrainian drone attack near Kerch killed two people.
In Kyiv, officials said overnight Russian attacks damaged and closed two of the city’s main bridges and killed two people.

effects.label: Russian supply lines
effects.t: Road traffic to Crimea over the bridge is stopped.

effects.label: Kyiv residents
effects.t: Two main river crossings in the capital are closed for repairs.
